about.title: Professional Summary
about.body: Senior engineer and applied scientist with 10+ years of experience designing, validating, and scaling complex technical systems across industry and research environments. Strong Python background spanning data analysis, computer vision, ML pipelines, experimental workflow automation, and decision-support tooling. Proven record leading R&D initiatives, structuring data workflows, integrating heterogeneous data sources, and translating messy real-world signals into reliable technical outputs. Brings an unusual combination of engineering rigor, product mindset, and hands-on delivery that fits data-intensive roles requiring problem solving, ownership, and cross-functional collaboration.

experience.title: Professional Experience

experience.role: Lead of Technology Development / Research Engineer
experience.domain: R&D, AI, product validation, technical leadership
bullets: Led a two-engineer team developing the DNV-certified BioRen AFS HN2 antifouling system in an industrial R&D setting.
Designed and improved data-driven experimental workflows combining instrumentation, control, and analysis for validation and product development.
Built a computer vision pipeline for biofouling assessment using drone and ROV imagery, supporting classification and R&D decision making with Python-based workflows.
Structured laboratory processes and data flows while founding the Electronics Laboratory and helping create the Biotechnology Research Laboratory.
Planned and executed validation and reliability test campaigns, improving equipment robustness and reducing technical risk.
Coordinated technical documentation, compliance contributions, and IP/patent activities linked to product development.

experience.company: Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio)
bullets: Developed specialized instrumentation and automation systems for five experimental physics laboratories (magnetometry, scanning magnetic microscopy, rock characterization).
Designed acquisition and processing workflows in MATLAB and laboratory software, connecting measurement hardware to digital analysis pipelines.
Supported advanced research through robust measurement systems, signal stability improvements, and repeatable data collection processes.
Contributed to scientific output across magnetometry, scanning magnetic microscopy, and rock characterization, with multiple peer-reviewed publications.
Contributed to the OneGeo open-source petrography platform for geological sample analysis.
Developed automation solutions using Arduino, Python, and KiCad, with version control through GitHub.
Supported image-related and experimental workflows in a geoscience research environment.
Develop scripts and analytical routines in Python, MATLAB, and LabVIEW for engineering data analysis and automation.
Deliver end-to-end technical solutions from concept design and circuit development to implementation and validation.
Support graduate-level projects involving modeling, measurement, and digital processing workflows.
Developed naval robotic systems and mechatronic control strategies in a research environment.
Conducted modeling, simulation, and validation studies for dynamic mechanical systems.
